title: Define rpm manifest section contract
summary: Extend the package-manager manifest contract with an rpm-specific manifest section (spec file metadata, scriptlet placeholders, file ownership, systemd service placeholder, requires declaration) following the homebrew section pattern, with empty placeholders and a validator hook. Publication and signing remain human-owned.
expectedFailureModes: RPM manifest section ships without a schema validator and drifts into machine-local install paths.
docs/status.md overclaims RPM package availability before repository custody is decided.
Validator hook is added but not wired into validate.sh --scripts, so regressions slip past CI.
humanEscalation: RPM repository hosting, signing keys, and uploads remain human-owned.
nextAction: Add an rpm section to the package-manager manifest schema with required fields (spec metadata, requires, scriptlets, service unit, file ownership), emit empty placeholders, register a validator hook, and document the contract in docs/distribution-readiness.md without claiming rpm packages ship.
